repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button != "pushed")
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve_open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a `cycle` with a rising-edge wait on `Button.Button == "pushed"`. The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only evaluates at the start of the wrapper period (0 ms). Since the input became true at 0 ms and held through 100 ms, the rising edge occurs at 0 ms, but the candidate's `if` condition is false (null != "pushed"), so no action is taken. The rising edge is missed because the candidate does not block on the edge transition.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` polling with a rising-edge state machine. This blocks until the predicate transitions from false to true, then executes the body, ensuring the action occurs at the exact instant of the rising edge as required by the IR.
